message.content: A cell that contains more than one nucleus is called a **multinucleated cell**. In biology, such cells are often referred to as a **syncytium** (a multinucleated syncytial cell) or, in the context of immune responses, as a **multinucleated giant cell**. These cells arise when several individual cells fuse together, resulting in a single cell with multiple nuclei.
